title: Execute Orange Team Legacy Modernization & Backlog Schema Alignment
details: Renamed repository to Backlog-Schema, standardized all documentation on backlog.json, scaffolded .dev/ hub, .agents/ workspace, in-repo docs/ wiki, and completed .github/ governance suite.

title: Codify JLDN Universal Taxonomy Standard and Zero-Collision Vocabulary
details: Eliminated terminology overlaps by explicitly separating Type, Domain, Kind, Scope, Action, and Category. Replaced [TYPE] with [KIND] in task IDs and set PROJ and DOCS as universal domains.

title: Migrate PROJ universal domain to ROOT and 3-letter generation codes
details: Deprecate PROJ domain to eliminate taxonomy collision. Codified ROOT as universal domain and [GEN] (e.g. G08) for generation-specific infrastructure tasks.

title: Red Team: Taxonomy Regex Rejects Alphanumeric Domains
details: The taxonomy ID validation regex in docs/specification.md strictly enforces [A-Z], which rejects newly adopted alphanumeric generation domains (e.g., G08). Update regex to [A-Z0-9] support.

title: White Team: Source of Truth Parity Break on PROJ Domain
details: The docs/specification.md file still declares PROJ as the universal domain and uses it in JSON examples, violating the newly enacted ROOT & [GEN] rule. Update all documentation references to align with the active schema.

title: Deprecate target_file string for target_files array
details: Deprecate the singular target_file key in favor of a target_files JSON array. This array tracks localized modifications by file path without recording brittle line numbers, providing forensic tracking for non-git environments.
